hook: Your face is a boarding pass at some airports.
title: Your Face Is Your Boarding Pass in India
description:
At some Indian airports, DigiYatra lets a camera read your face and open the gate. You register once in the app first. Delhi, Bengaluru and Varanasi were among the first to use it.

#Shorts #DigiYatra #TechFacts
comment_prompt: Would you use face boarding? Yes or no
